page_title: LAZ 0-3 COM | Lazio v Como 19/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Michael Fabbri has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Alex Valle (Como) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
88' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going low in the middle of the goal, but Jean Butez has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
88' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
87' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Now Lazio have a corner.
85' Here is a change. Kenneth Taylor is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio).
81' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Nico Paz is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Como).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) comes onto the pitch for Jesus Rodriguez.
80' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
76' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

76' Adam Marusic (Lazio) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lazio are going to take it.
75' Stefan Posch (Como) receives a yellow card.
74' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Martin Baturina.
74' Ivan Provedel pulls off a great save to deny Jacobo Ramon (Como), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
73' A dangerous looking corner kick from Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is cleared to safety by the defence.
70' Sergi Roberto (Como) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
68' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
65' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Maxence Caqueret will be replaced by Sergi Roberto (Como).
64' It is time for a substitution. Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) is on for Luca Pellegrini.
62' Stefan Posch (Como) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) was quite harsh and Michael Fabbri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
58' Nico Paz (Como) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
57' Adam Marusic (Lazio) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
54' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
53' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) for Danilo Cataldi.
53' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Petar Ratkov and he is replaced by Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
53' Here comes a substitution. Matteo Cancellieri is given a rest as he is replaced by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
49' 0 - 3 Goal! Nico Paz (Como) is teed up on the edge of the box by Martin Baturina, and his howitzer of a shot inside the left post gives the keeper no chance. 0:3.
48' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
47' Petar Ratkov (Lazio) and Matteo Cancellieri try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Cesc Fabregas gives a chance to Stefan Posch (Como) and Ivan Smolcic is off.
46' Referee Michael Fabbri blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
45+4' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Michael Fabbri blows for a foul.
45+3' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Petar Ratkov (Lazio), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
45+3' Alex Valle (Como) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+1' The game is interrupted now, Alex Valle (Como) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.

43' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
42' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Michael Fabbri and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
39' Michael Fabbri couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) and blew his whistle.
36' Nico Paz (Como) takes the corner but it's cleared.
35' Ivan Provedel anticipates the direction of the penalty by Nico Paz (Como). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
33' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty to Como!

33' Play continues despite the shouts by some Como players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Michael Fabbri interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
28' Maxence Caqueret (Como) commits a rough foul. Michael Fabbri stops the game and makes a call.
26' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Jean Butez is equal to it and makes an easy save.
24' 0 - 2 Goal! Nico Paz (Como) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:2.
22' Ivan Smolcic (Como) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
21' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) for his blatant foul.
21' A fine pass finds Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Jean Butez reacts superbly to deny him.
20' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Fabbri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
17' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

14' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Jean Butez pulls off an easy save.
13' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
12' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
11' Good clearance! Petar Ratkov (Lazio) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
7' Adam Marusic (Lazio) and Reda Belahyane attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
6' Adam Marusic (Lazio) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
4' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
2' 0 - 1 Martin Baturina (Como) finds some space just outside the penalty area after exchanging the ball with his teammate and strikes a shot towards goal that goes inside the right post!
1' The first half has started.
Lazio will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Michael Fabbri.
